mapper.select: SELECT v.id,v.user_id,v.code,v.snippet,v.reviewed,v.created_at, COALESCE(p.nickname,p.username,'用户') AS user_name,p.phone AS user_phone,p.user_role FROM t_chat_violations v LEFT JOIN t_profiles p ON p.id=v.user_id ORDER BY v.reviewed ASC,v.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_chat_violations SET reviewed=1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.invite_tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS people, COALESCE(SUM(rl.amt),0)/100.0 AS paid_cny FROM t_profiles p LEFT JOIN (SELECT inviter_id,SUM(amount) AS amt FROM t_reward_ledger WHERE currency='cny' AND status!='revoked' GROUP BY inviter_id) rl ON rl.inviter_id=p.id WHERE p.invite_tier!='l0' GROUP BY p.invite_tier ORDER BY p.invite_tier

SELECT id,user_role,enterprise_name,enterprise_verify_status FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_profiles SET enterprise_verify_status=CASE WHEN #{approved} THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END WHERE id=#{id} AND enterprise_verify_status='pending'
UPDATE t_kyc_documents SET status=CASE WHEN #{approved} THEN 'approved' ELSE 'rejected' END WHERE user_id=#{id} AND doc_type='enterprise_license' AND status='pending'
